title: High angle (looking down)
purpose: The camera is above eye level. Diminishes a figure and opens the ground.
keeps: the angle, measured on the take
cannot: the figure seen from that angle (the pack's low view is cropped at the knees and cannot be footed, so the person is still an eye-level view)
the angle in a place with no straight verticals (a harbour of masts cannot be measured)
measured: the same arithmetic as the low angle with the sign reversed; exact to 0.02
hint: The camera is above eye level. Diminishes a figure and opens the ground.
